transcript.text: Alright everyone, we need to get the Alpha and Bravo vehicle-operator recertification scheduled for next week. We've got two four-hour blocks available: Monday 0800-1200 and Tuesday 1300-1700. We need one evaluator per cohort, and each evaluator has to be listed on the training schedule. Before I publish the final schedule, I want to hash this out in our coordination huddle. What do we know about evaluator availability and any conflicts with either of those time blocks?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I checked the training database this morning — the only evaluator currently authorized for the Alpha cohort is Sgt. Lewis, and he is available Monday 0800-1200. The evaluator roster hasn't been attached to the weekly schedule yet, but the authorization is confirmed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a conflict on the Bravo side. I confirmed the bay booking today — Bravo's assigned vehicles are booked for preventive maintenance Monday afternoon and Tuesday morning, so Bravo can only train during the Tuesday 1300-1700 block, after motor pool release. The maintenance calendar hasn't been cross-referenced with the training schedule yet, so this constraint hasn't been reflected in any planning so far.
